config.stage: input-selection-only; user confirmation required before inference

reference.selection: Reuse existing input-RGB-localized neck boxes; executor diagnostic regions, not user-confirmed anatomical truth. No output inspection.
reference.tracking: Each non-keyframe independently matches the nearest RGB anchor (tie: earlier frame); native-resolution grayscale TM_CCOEFF_NORMED on the anchor neck rectangle. Translation only; no coordinate or disparity interpolation.
reference.reference_value: Median original q/255 over neck rectangle intersect original DAVIS ID!=0 union, evaluated separately on each frame. Preserve fractional medians without an extra PNG8 quantization.

candidate_rule.coordinate_system: Original VDA/DAVIS1920x1080 pixel grid; d=q/255, normalized disparity, not metric depth.
candidate_rule.test: abs(d_t-r_t)>0.10 within original DAVIS ID!=0 union; strict greater-than; two-sided.
candidate_rule.multiple_components: Keep all qualifying components, including both higher/lower disparity sides; never select a winner.
candidate_rule.too_large_policy: If union of all size-qualified components exceeds25% of subject, skip entire frame. Retain raw candidate visualization and reasons.
candidate_rule.rationale: Input-only abs-difference medians0.035-0.078, most95th percentiles0.13-0.18. A single round0.10 threshold targets a disparity tail rather than all subject pixels; it is not an error detector.64 native pixels removes tiny islands; a conservative quarter-subject cap prevents broad intervention. No threshold/area sweep or output-based selection.
candidate_rule.failure_policy: Invalid reference or empty candidates: retain original condition; no interpolation. No forced correction on all25 frames.
candidate_rule.status: single proposal for user selection review; no user approval and no ATB inference

config.missing_policy: Failed localization, invalid reference, empty selection, or configured area limit: keep original condition on that frame; retain attempted location and exact reason. No interpolation, smoothing or hysteresis.
config.intervention_plan: After user approval only: replace q by the same-frame neck reference within selected native pixels; construct CoC in original author order with original per-frame focus/K, transplant CoC only to all real source-frame occurrences; original MPI/RGB/padding/model/RNG/cache unchanged.

limits: Reference localization is RGB-anchor-assisted; this is not a fully automatic method.
Large discrepancy marks a candidate, not a true depth error. Neck disparity is a diagnostic reference, not geometric truth.
Native masks never change background. Author resize/antialias may spread condition differences across the projected mask boundary; recorded separately.
No temporal smoothing/hysteresis; invalid frame21 and fixed area skips are deliberately exposed.
No ATB, depth, optical-flow or other neural inference; no output quality claim.
